story: Hear the World’s Oldest Known Song, “Hurrian Hymn No. 6” Written 3400 Years Ago
text: In a somewhat similar vein, here's Peter Pringle singing the opening lines of The Epic of Gilgamesh (written 4,000 years ago), using our best guess at Sumerian pronunciation and playing a modern recreation of an instrument that the Sumerians would have had, as an attempt to guess what ancient Sumerian music might have sounded like: [VIDEO]

story: How did Ancient Greek music sound?
text: If you like this kind of stuff, you should listen to Peter Pringle singing the Epic of Gilgamesh while playing a reconstructed oud. While the melodies/rhythms he uses are his creation, the words are from the epic itself which was itself 2000 years old by the time of Ancient Greece. [VIDEO]

story: How did Ancient Greek music sound?
